requirements.title: HUGE integer result is r to the q minus one
requirements.definition: For integer X, HUGE(X) has the value r**q - 1 for the integer model of X's type and kind.

pending.HUGE-integer-model-upper-bound: Derive the integer model value from r=RADIX(x) and q=DIGITS(x): compute r**q - 1 without overflow in the same kind by accumulating (r**(q-1) - 1)*r + (r - 1), assert HUGE(x) equals that derived value, and mutate the final digit or kind to make the comparison load-bearing.
pending.HUGE-integer-distinguishes-kinds: Use two selected integer kinds with different RADIX/DIGITS-derived model values and assert their HUGE results equal their separately accumulated r**q - 1 values; mutation replaces the selected kind with default kind.

requirements.title: HUGE real result is the model largest value
requirements.definition: For real X, HUGE(X) has value (1 - b**(-p)) * b**emax for X's real model.

pending.HUGE-real-model-largest-value: Use the 16.9.96 real-model result value with 16.9.85 EXPONENT, 16.9.90 FRACTION, and 16.4 model definitions: assert EXPONENT(HUGE(x)) == MAXEXPONENT(x) and FRACTION(HUGE(x)) == 1 - REAL(RADIX(x), KIND(x))**(-DIGITS(x)); this decomposes the model value exactly without forming an overflowing RADIX**MAXEXPONENT product.
pending.HUGE-real-distinguishes-kinds: Use two real kinds with different RADIX, DIGITS, or MAXEXPONENT model parameters in the selected profile and assert each HUGE result satisfies its own EXPONENT and FRACTION decomposition from 16.9.96, 16.9.85, 16.9.90, and 16.4 rather than a copied literal.
